items.text: The quit tools keep your answers in this browser only, under the name quit-v1. They are not sent to us.

items.text: When you open a tool or finish a step, the site counts it without your answers. It is sent only which addiction, which tool and which step. If the link you came from carries a short tag, that tag is kept for that visit only.
items.factRef: 5. /api/quit/count (payload addiction, tool, step, optional src; quit-src in sessionStorage, section 4)

items.text: If your browser blocks storage, the tools still work until you close the page.
items.factRef: 4. Browser storage keys: quit-v1, in-memory fallback if storage blocked

items.text: The Black Box also keeps its record on your device, including what you type into it.
items.factRef: 4. Browser storage keys: vice-blackbox-v1 (whole Black Box record incl. typed thoughts)

items.text: To remove all of this, clear this site's data in your browser settings.
items.factRef: 12. Local-only data (signed out): removed by clearing site data

sections.heading: What we keep when you make an account

items.text: Your email, your password (handled by our login provider), your name and the time zone of your browser.
items.factRef: 1. Accounts and login: sign-up collects email, password, full name, timezone (app/auth/sign-up/page.tsx)

items.text: What you type into the parts of the site you use while signed in, such as the Black Box, the plan and journal, the time and energy audit, the time tracker, workouts and health logs, and the training tracking.
items.factRef: 3. Database tables a signed-in user writes (vice_reports, life_plan_*, audit_*, timetrack_*, workout and health tables, sessions/approaches)

items.text: Things you delete inside the site are hidden, not erased, until your account is deleted.
items.factRef: 3. Vice / quit: deletes are soft (deleted_at set, row kept), app/api/black-box/route.ts

items.text: For a payment, we keep the payment ids and the amount, not your card details.
items.factRef: 3. purchases table (stripe ids, product, amount_cents, status); 9. Stripe: no card data in code

items.text: Our log of AI features keeps which feature ran, the model, token counts and cost. It does not keep what you wrote.
items.factRef: Planner check 2026-11-18: live ai_usage_logs has no column for chat text

items.text: When the site crashes, it sends a short error report with the page path and a build number. Typed text, emails and address parts are scrubbed first. If you are signed in the report carries your account id.
items.factRef: 6. Error reporting: fields, scrub in src/shared/errorScrubService.ts, userId if signed in

items.text: The only cookies we set are the ones that keep you signed in.
items.factRef: 2. Cookies: only Supabase auth session cookies

items.text: We never sell your data.
items.factRef: Owner promise in the Phase 6 brief (not a code fact); 9. no ad or analytics scripts found

items.text: We show no ads and run no tracking or analytics scripts on this site.
items.factRef: 9. Analytics, tracking scripts: none found

items.text: We never show your answers to anyone.
items.factRef: Owner promise in the Phase 6 brief (not a code fact); 5. count route carries no answers

items.text: Vercel hosts the site. Supabase holds the database and the login. Both may keep their own server logs of requests.
items.factRef: 10. Processors and hosting; 11. Platform request logs outside the repo

items.text: Stripe handles payments.
items.factRef: 9. Stripe: src/settings/stripe.ts, purchases table

items.text: Some AI features for paying members send the text you type to an AI model to answer it: the practice chats, the scenario lab, the coach Q&A and the values exercise.
items.factRef: 8. AI providers that receive user-typed text (Anthropic chat/scenario lab, Ollama Q&A and value inference; premium-only routes)

items.text: The practice chats and the scenario lab use Anthropic's models. The coach Q&A and the values exercise use a separate model service we set up.
items.factRef: 8. Ollama via OLLAMA_API_URL; host not verified

items.text: If you connect a calendar link or a webhook in the time tracker, the site contacts the address you gave.

items.text: If you turn on notifications, your browser maker's push service delivers them.
